desc: Derive the feasible upper-length interval \([\max(0,H-D_i),\min(U_i,H)]\) for a fixed \(H\).
Propagate feasible intervals along the tooth chain using the adjacent difference limit \(X\).
Establish that feasibility is downward-monotone in \(H\).
Implement binary search for the maximum feasible \(H\) and compute \(\sum_i(U_i+D_i)-NH\).
Verify the complete Python program on all provided samples and ensure 64-bit-safe output.
